sources.entry: Raycast - Launcher and command palette with extensions, snippets, notes, and AI.

summary.name: Raycast
summary.one_liner: Raycast is an extendable launcher and productivity toolkit that bundles app launching, extensions, snippets, quicklinks, notes, and built-in AI.
use_cases: launch apps and files from the keyboard
expand text snippets by typing a keyword
create quicklinks to open sites and apps
use AI chat and an AI agent across everyday tools
summary.what_it_does: Raycast is a keyboard-driven launcher that runs a collection of productivity tools from one interface. Its listed features include snippets that expand when you type a keyword, quicklinks and hotkeys or aliases for launching apps and commands, and Raycast Notes for quick capture. It also covers file search, script running, window management, unit and currency conversion, translation, emoji insertion, and finding text in screenshots. A built-in AI Agent and Quick AI hotkey connect AI to the tools you already use. Developers can build extensions with a documented API and UI component library, then submit them to the Raycast Store.
notable: Built-in AI Agent and Quick AI hotkey that work alongside everyday tools
Extension API and UI component library so developers can build and publish extensions to the Raycast Store
Snippets, quicklinks, and hotkeys/aliases for keyboard-first workflows
Raycast Notes for capturing thoughts quickly
caveats: Page states a 99.8% crash-free rate but gives no source or time period for it
Page does not detail which AI features require a paid tier or any usage limits
